summary: Iteration 15 - Testing Global Database page and Admin Panel access. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working correctly.

All 4 tabs working: Explore (resources with Featured badges), Trending (hashtags + categories), World Map (Google Maps integration), Top Contributors (leaderboard)
Admin can add research resources via modal with all required fields (title, description, URL, category, location, tags, featured checkbox)
Book promotion 'Letters to Evelyn' is prominently displayed on the page
Admin Control link visible at top of sidebar for admin users
Admin Panel shows system status, app version, subscribers, revenue
